src/dawn/native/vulkan/CommandBufferVk.c.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/native/vulkan/CommandBufferVk.c.message: This comment should be associated with the dirtying caused by the resource table at [1]

src/dawn/native/vulkan/CommandBufferVk.c.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/native/vulkan/CommandBufferVk.c.message: Instead of this, let's keep this block in [1] and instead clear the mLastResourceTable at [2].

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: Why? Can we have a TODO?

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: Any reason we need two bindgroups in this test?

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Shaobo Yan
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: To ensure this is "dirty all bindgroups" but not "dirty highest index " bind groups. But it seems not necessary.

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: We could add a push constant size defaulted to 0 to [`utils::MakePipelineLayout`](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:third_party/dawn/src/dawn/utils/WGPUHelpers.cpp;drc=2546bab52b03777485a99528329c161ad1e751b3;l=236)

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: This VS is the same between both pipelines, we could have one module and just set the entryPoint to something different for the FS of both pipelines.

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: This could directly return the values in one of the bindgroups, which would remove the need for the math to compute the expected values below.

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Shaobo Yan
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: Do an experiment and it seems test could catch the issue https://dawn-review.googlesource.com/c/dawn/+/296155?tab=checks

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: Why do we need the uniform buffer? A single VkDescriptorSet should be sufficient to test the issue. In shaders we can write immediate values to `output` and that's sufficient to test the potential issue?

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: Defaulted layouts are not compatible between pipelines at all. (I hope we change that one day)

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
Shaobo Yan
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: Sure. Issue filed https://issues.chromium.org/u/1/issues/491515776 (No techdebt in type in my drop box list. Choose internal cleanup and use [TechDebt] in title).

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: This is a bit surprising to me, can you link one of the failures?

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Shaobo Yan
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: This fails the bots. So keep the origin logic.

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: Wow I forgot that GetRequiredFeatures didn't cause DawnTest to actually skip if the feature isn't available. That's a big gotcha. Can you file a issue with type techdebt to fix that?

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: nit: It also needs to exist in the layout, otherwise as far as the Vulkan backend is concerned, it doesn't exist.

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: nit: created on pipeline fully then the other?

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: We don't even need to put something in the resource table for this test, since all we need is the resource table to be bound correctly in the Vulkan backend.

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Corentin Wallez
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: And the VVL will complain, which should be sufficient for the test, or did the VVLs not complain? (with `--enable-backend-validation` (`=full`?))?

src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.author: Shaobo Yan
src/dawn/tests/end2end/ImmediateDataTest.message: I cannot see the error in my local machine. But the experiment here https://dawn-review.googlesource.com/c/dawn/+/295916 shows validation layer (at least in bots) should catch this. Done.
